items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: I had in the band such men as Big Catlett Sid Catley... Bushell Butch Elber was with me and Cedric, they came back with me. And then was, I don't know, not Johnny Mitchell, he stayed over there.

ctx.x: So I was back there the next day with my own boys and we got into what trouble they didn't get that day, so see. Anyhow, so they all had a good time, but Johnny Mitchell went to -- see the other guys wasn't thinking. But, as the leader, I had to keep a certain amount of prestige up. So, but now, the Germans came in like a bunch of flies and all. The next day they grabbed us and they took us to all the places -- now this is where -- first they took us to and the droskys too, we had never seen droskys, too. You…
